instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In a modern cafe with a large beige arched partition, the woman in the beige blazer and blue bandana (R1) sits on the left, smiling and gesturing with both hands during a lively conversation. On the right, the woman in the pink corduroy blazer and glasses (R2) sits in a wheelchair, smiling warmly as she listens with her hands in her lap. They sit opposite each other at a small black table with a coffee cup. The scene is bathed in warm, natural daylight, creating soft shadows and a pleasant, friendly atmosphere.
